title: Timed Recovery Safe Gradient Flows for Constrained Nonlinear Programming
summary: This paper studies how to relax pointwise feasibility in continuous-time dynamics for inequality-constrained nonlinear programming while retaining a quantitative feasible-recovery guarantee. Existing safe gradient flows enforce forward invariance of the feasible set, which yields an anytime-feasible dynamics but can be overly restrictive for optimization because it suppresses transient infeasible motion that may be essential for effective descent.
